generator_cmd: printf %s 'Nice work decoding this warmup! To solve: maple-raven-91' | perl -e 'local $/; print join(" ", map { sprintf "%016b", $_ } unpack("n*", <STDIN>))'  # UTF-8 bytes packed two per 16-bit group (the wint family): no all-zero halves
oracle_cmd: perl -e 'print pack("n*", map { oct("0b$_") } split / /, $ARGV[0])' "$encoded" | iconv -f UTF-16BE -t UTF-8 | iconv -f UTF-8 -t ASCII  # CJK, not ASCII text: iconv rejects
